component.name: Swift
component.summary: The browser that moves at your speed

description.p: Swift is a fast, privacy-first desktop browser. It cuts the invisible weight out of browsing — trackers, fingerprinting scripts, telemetry and tabs that quietly eat memory — and opens a local-first app suite behind one device-local Swift ID. Nothing is stored on a Swift server.

ul.li: Bundled tracker and ad blocking with no remote list to download
Fingerprint defense, HTTPS upgrading and Global Privacy Control
Turbo mode skips heavy third-party images and media
Idle tabs go to sleep and reload when you return
Local-only history, bookmarks and settings with private tabs
Swift ID, Chat, Meet, AI, Docs, Sheets, Decks, Notes, Calendar, Drive and Tasks
Encrypted local Drive files and on-device AI search
Editions from one codebase: Lite, Enterprise, Beta, Nightly and Developer

description.p: Swift Mail is coming soon: a custom domain is needed before @swift.email addresses can be created.

description.p: First release: bundled tracker blocking, fingerprint defenses, HTTPS upgrading, Turbo mode, tab sleeping, private tabs, a local privacy dashboard and twelve local-first Swift apps with device-local Swift ID.
